h2: Explore every Portable Cabin size & its applications
intro: Nine standard sizes, one specification — pick the footprint that matches how you'll use it, built to lift, move and reuse across sites, with fixed base prices and delivery in 7–21 working days.

panels.paragraph: The 10×10 ft is the smallest one-room cabin: 100 sq ft you can crane onto any flat base and use the same day, then lift and shift when the job moves. Right-sized for a single-person office, a guard or supervisor room, or a lockable store.
A narrow 160 sq ft unit that moves easily where access is tight and still relocates on a standard trailer. Suited to a slim office, a reception or a store that needs to shift with the work.

Our most-ordered relocatable cabin: 200 sq ft with room for four to six people, desks and files. The size most teams specify first — delivered fitted with electricals, lighting and insulation, and picked up and re-sited as one unit when the location changes.
Two extra feet of width for a more comfortable office, a retail counter with space behind it, or a combined work-and-store layout — still a single relocatable unit.
A long 300 sq ft unit for a multi-desk office, a bigger shop, or a clean room-plus-store split. It relocates as one piece on a 40 ft trailer when the site changes.
A 320 sq ft corridor-style cabin that puts length where you need it — an extended office run or a long store — while staying slim enough to travel on a 40 ft trailer.
A near-square 400 sq ft footprint for a larger single room or a two-zone layout, engineered to stay liftable and reusable across sites despite the wider body.
The full-length 400 sq ft cabin: a spacious relocatable room for a team office, a showroom or a multi-use space, sized to travel on a 40 ft open trailer and re-site as one unit.
The most floor area you can lift and reuse as one cabin: 480 sq ft for a broad office, a large retail space or a combined layout, before joining modules for anything bigger.
